verdict.rationale: Reflect does not store notes as local files you own. Its only ownership mechanism is a manual export to open formats like HTML or Markdown, which the founder also cites as the answer to lock-in. Notes are otherwise held in its end-to-end-encrypted service, and the API cannot even serve note contents. Missing for 10: notes stored in local files or a local-first store readable without the app, any documented offline mode, and independent evidence of offline use.
